ref_atoms.ref_content: Sequentially test each host to access any device
Enable all hosts to randomly send transactions to any device

Control delays through plusargs to create tests for below types of delay
- Zero delay for sending a/d_valid and a/d_ready
- Large delay from 0 ~ 1000 cycles
- Small delay (0-10 cycles) for a_channel, large delay (0-1000 cycles) for d_channel

- Host randomly drives transactions with mapped and unmapped address
- Ensure DUT returns d_error=1 if address is unmapped and transaction isn't passed down to any device
- Additionally, d_error: dKnown_A: Make sure it's not X when d_valid is high.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 明确规定了未映射地址时 d_error=1 的具体硬件行为，涉及特定信号 d_error 和精确的未映射条件

ref_atoms.ref_content:
- Drive any random value on size, mask, opcode in both channels
- Ensure everything just pass through host to device or device to host

- Randomly pick a device, make all hosts to access this device
- If the device isn't accessible for the host, let the host randomly access the other devices
Test all hosts use same ID at the same same

- Combine all sequences and run in parallel
- Add random reset between each iteration

- Inject reset while stress_all is running, after reset is completed, kill the stress seq and then start a new stress seq
- Run a few iteration to ensure reset doesn't break the design
a_opcode: legalAOpcode_[M/A]: Only the following 3 opcodes are legal: Get, PutFullData, PutPartialData. See spec section 6.2.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specifies allowed opcode values on signal a_opcode, providing a concrete protocol constraint for verification.

ref_atoms.ref_content: a_param: legalAParam_[M/A]: This field is reserved, it must be 0. See spec section 6.2.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Constrains a_param to be zero, a checkable protocol rule on a specific signal.

ref_atoms.ref_content: a_size: sizeMatchesMask_[M/A]: a_size can be calculated from a_mask as follows: 2^{a_size} must equal $countones(a_mask). See spec section 4.6. Also, aKnown_A: Ensure a_size is not X when a_valid is high.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Determines a_size from a_mask contents, a precise arithmetic condition verifiable in simulation.

ref_atoms.ref_content: a_source: pendingReqPerSrc_[M/A]: There should be no more than one pending request per each source ID. See spec section 5.4. Also, aKnown_A: Make sure a_source is not X when a_valid is high.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Enforces one-in-flight request per source ID, a critical ordering constraint on a_source.

ref_atoms.ref_content: a_address: addrSizeAligned_[M/A]: a_address must be aligned to a_size: a_address & ((1 << a_size) - 1) == 0. See spec section 4.6. Also, aKnown_A: Make sure a_address is not X when a_valid is high.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Checks address alignment against a_size, a precise arithmetic condition on a_address.

ref_atoms.ref_content: a_mask: contigMask_[M/A]: a_mask must be contiguous for Get and PutFullData (but not for PutPartialData). See spec sections 4.6 and 6.2. Also, sizeMatchesMask_[M/A]: a_mask must satisfy sizeMatchesMask check (see a_size above). Also, aKnown_A: Ensure a_mask is not X when a_valid is high.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Requires contiguous mask bits for specific opcodes, a protocol rule on a_mask.

ref_atoms.ref_content: a_data: aDataKnown_[M/A]: a_data should not be X for opcodes PutFullData and PutPartialData (it can be X for Get). Bytes of a_data, whose corresponding a_mask bits are 0, can be X. See spec section 4.6.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Constrains a_data X handling based on opcode and mask, a detailed protocol check for write data.

ref_atoms.ref_content: a_user: aKnown_A: Make sure it's not X when a_valid is high.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Checks a_user is known when a_valid is high, a validity check for user signals.

ref_atoms.ref_content: a_valid: aKnown_A: Make sure it's not X (except during reset).
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Verifies a_valid is not X outside reset, a fundamental protocol signal check.

ref_atoms.ref_content: a_ready: aReadyKnown_A: Make sure it's not X (except during reset).
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Checks a_ready is not X outside reset, ensuring handshake signal integrity.

ref_atoms.ref_content: d_opcode: respOpcode_[A/M]: If the original request was Get, then the corresponding response must be AccessAckData. Otherwise, the response must be AccessAck. See spec section 6.2.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specifies response opcode based on original request, a critical protocol linkage on d_opcode.

ref_atoms.ref_content: d_param: legalDParam_[A/M]: This field is reserved, it must be 0. See spec section 6.2.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Constrains d_param to zero, a deterministic checkable rule on the response channel.

ref_atoms.ref_content: d_size: respSzEqReqSz_[A/M]: The response must have the same size as the original request. See spec section 6.2.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Requires response size to match request size, a direct equality check on d_size.

ref_atoms.ref_content: d_source: respMustHaveReq_[A/M]: For each response, there must have been a corresponding request with the same source ID value. See spec section 5.4. Also, noOutstandingReqsAtEndOfSim_A: Make sure that there are no outstanding requests at the end of the simulation. Also, dKnown_A: Make sure d_source is not X when d_valid is high.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Ensures every response matches a prior request by source ID, a fundamental transaction tracking check.

ref_atoms.ref_content: d_sink: dKnown_A: Make sure it's not X when d_valid is high.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Checks d_sink is known during valid responses, a signal integrity check.

ref_atoms.ref_content: d_data: dDataKnown_[A/M]: d_data should not be X for AccessAckData. Bytes of d_data, whose corresponding mask bits of the original request are 0, can be X. See spec section 4.6.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Defines X handling for response data based on opcode and mask, a detailed data integrity check.

ref_atoms.ref_content: d_user: dKnown_A: Make sure it's not X when d_valid is high.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Ensures d_user is not X during valid responses, a user-signal validity check.

ref_atoms.ref_content: d_valid: dKnown_A: Make sure it's not X (except during reset).
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Verifies d_valid is not X outside reset, a fundamental response handshake check.

ref_atoms.ref_content: d_ready: dReadyKnown_A: Make sure it's not X (except during reset).
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Checks d_ready is not X outside reset, ensuring proper response handshake integrity.
